description:
What this is. One page for each person covered by the clinic scheme. You do not usually create these yourself — one appears when you sign an employee up, or when you sign up someone you are about to hire. Open a person's page to see whether the clinic accepted them, when they last went in, and what has happened to them since.

A guided tour. Opening this step walks you through the page one box at a time and explains what each one is for. You can start it again whenever you like with the small i button at the top of the page.

Where to find it. To see the ones already there, open Cova Members from the menu on the left.
name: Review the Cova Member Register
title: Cova Members — the list of people covered
